authority: Owner requested the proposed API-first correction be planned and started on 2026-09-08.
objective: Make workflow-oriented ETABS API discovery repeatable before freezing new source/topology contracts.

bounded_units.outcome: Maintained capability catalogue and static assembly inspection, reusing the existing exact getter profiles.
Worker command exports a source-hash-bound discovery report without attaching to ETABS or overwriting prior evidence.
Focused tests, installed assembly discovery and maintained plan/user entry points; one bounded candidate.

acceptance_rows.outcome: Inventory reports each selected method as present or missing, exact overloads, return types, parameter names/types/directions and associated enum definitions.
Registered getter signature matches and mismatches are explicit; presence never becomes a claim of live behavior or general runtime compatibility.
Direct Boolean/String returns and CSI integer-status methods remain distinguishable; discovery executes no target method, constructor or getter.
CLI binds report to the inspected assembly bytes and identifies the capability catalogue; an existing output is preserved and invalid input fails visibly.
Actual installed API discovery confirms the tested signatures for supports, material overrides and output stations and records the absent GetComboStrength candidate honestly.
Existing worker context/force dispatch, getter matrices and snapshot formats retain their meaning. Documentation identifies live source-fact capture as the next packet.

non_goals: No live API calls, model attachment, setters, analysis, design execution or installation change in this first packet.
No broadened beam design profile, new source snapshot fields or weakened existing getter admission.
No universal API coverage or claim that discovered methods are qualified for target-model behavior.
No unrelated dependency, UI, engineering-math or repository-workflow change.
likely_pitfalls: Confusing method existence with exact signature compatibility or live qualification.
Assuming every getter returns an integer CSI status, or copying enum values between distinct enum types.
Creating another competing getter wrapper instead of describing the maintained definitions.
Using a stale assembly or allowing a failed export to overwrite earlier evidence.

verification.focused_tests: EtabsApiDiscoveryTests plus existing Wp10GetterAdapterTests and Wp10ContextCaptureTests on the Windows test project
verification.installed_evidence: Run the built worker inventory command against the installed ETABSv1.dll; record exact source/assembly/report hashes without starting ETABS.
verification.cumulative_gate: Broad Python and full repository check remain at the programme named cumulative gate; this packet uses affected .NET and document/control checks plus required hosted PR checks.
